entity.summary: Omnichain self-custodial perpetual-futures exchange infrastructure operating a shared central-limit order book with off-chain matching, on-chain settlement, and trading access through multiple independent front ends and APIs.
entity.notes: Current first-party documentation describes one shared perpetual-futures order book, self-custodial accounts, off-chain matching, on-chain settlement, API access, and trading through numerous builder front ends across EVM and non-EVM chains. Current independently maintained metrics report substantial non-zero 24-hour, 7-day, and 30-day perpetual volume, fees, and open interest. HEI records the shared Orderly exchange layer as one entity and does not treat every white-label interface as a separate exchange without independent identity evidence.
